subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-shaped internal traces be blocked by a broader shared outbound sanitizer or by a Discord-specific front-channel sanitizer?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses a security-sensitive output boundary where overmatching can hide legitimate user-visible code or JSON, while undermatching continues to expose internal tool traces.

options.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
options.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer to cover envelope-shaped internal traces and add cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

options.title: Discord-specific sanitizer
options.body: Keep the broader rule in Discord reply/send delivery only and prove that other channels either already sanitize or do not receive the same envelope shapes.

options.title: Defer to broader policy issue
options.body: Keep this issue blocked behind the broader inter-tool text leakage policy and accept that Discord remains exposed until that design lands.

recommendation.title: Shared outbound sanitizer
recommendation.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer to cover envelope-shaped internal traces and add cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the shared repair package and Discord sanitizer boundary involved in either implementation path.
